<?php
if(!defined('DATALIFEENGINE')) {
    die("Hacking attempt!");
}

function encrypt_value($string, $encryption_key) {
    return openssl_encrypt($string, "AES-256-CBC", $encryption_key, 0, substr(md5($encryption_key), 0, 16));
}

function decrypt_value($string, $encryption_key) {
    return openssl_decrypt($string, "AES-256-CBC", $encryption_key, 0, substr(md5($encryption_key), 0, 16));
}

function ai_log($action, $data = array()) {
    global $db, $member_id;
    
    $log = array(
        'user_id' => intval($member_id['user_id']),
        'action' => $db->safesql($action),
        'prompt' => isset($data['prompt']) ? $db->safesql($data['prompt']) : '',
        'response' => isset($data['response']) ? $db->safesql(json_encode($data['response'])) : '',
        'error' => isset($data['error']) ? $db->safesql($data['error']) : '',
        'ip' => get_ip()
    );
    
    $db->query("INSERT INTO " . PREFIX . "_ai_logs 
        (user_id, action, prompt, response, error, ip) 
        VALUES 
        ('{$log['user_id']}', '{$log['action']}', '{$log['prompt']}', '{$log['response']}', '{$log['error']}', '{$log['ip']}')");
        
    return $db->insert_id();
}

function get_ai_config() {
    global $db;
    
    $config = array(
        'api_key' => '',
        'model' => 'gpt-3.5-turbo',
        'max_tokens' => 1000,
        'temperature' => 0.7,
        'encryption_key' => ''
    );
    
    $result = $db->query("SELECT name, value, is_encrypted FROM " . PREFIX . "_ai_config");
    if ($result) {
        $encryption_key = '';
        while ($row = $db->get_row($result)) {
            if ($row['name'] === 'encryption_key') {
                $encryption_key = $row['value'];
                continue;
            }
            
            $value = $row['value'];
            if ($row['is_encrypted'] && !empty($encryption_key)) {
                $value = decrypt_value($value, $encryption_key);
            }
            
            $config[$row['name']] = $value;
        }
    }
    
    return $config;
}

function save_ai_config($config) {
    global $db;
    
    $result = $db->query("SELECT value FROM " . PREFIX . "_ai_config WHERE name = 'encryption_key'");
    $encryption_key = $db->get_row($result)['value'];
    
    foreach ($config as $name => $value) {
        $is_encrypted = ($name === 'api_key') ? 1 : 0;
        if ($is_encrypted) {
            $value = encrypt_value($value, $encryption_key);
        }
        
        $db->query("REPLACE INTO " . PREFIX . "_ai_config (name, value, is_encrypted) VALUES 
            ('" . $db->safesql($name) . "', 
             '" . $db->safesql($value) . "',
             '" . $is_encrypted . "')");
    }
    return true;
}

class AIContentGenerator {
    private $apiKey;
    private $model;
    private $maxTokens;
    private $temperature;
    
    public function __construct($config) {
        if (empty($config['api_key'])) {
            throw new Exception('API anahtarı bulunamadı. Admin panelinden ayarlayın.');
        }
        
        $this->apiKey = $config['api_key'];
        $this->model = $config['model'];
        $this->maxTokens = (int)$config['max_tokens'];
        $this->temperature = (float)$config['temperature'];
    }
    
    public function generateContent($prompt) {
        $url = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions';
        
        $headers = array(
            'Content-Type: application/json',
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->apiKey
        );
        
        $data = array(
            'model' => $this->model,
            'messages' => array(
                array(
                    'role' => 'user',
                    'content' => $prompt
                )
            ),
            'max_tokens' => $this->maxTokens,
            'temperature' => $this->temperature
        );
        
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($data));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        if ($httpCode === 200) {
            $result = json_decode($response, true);
            return array(
                'success' => true,
                'content' => $result['choices'][0]['message']['content']
            );
        } else {
            return array(
                'error' => 'API Hatası: ' . $httpCode,
                'details' => $response
            );
        }
    }
}
